traits.name: Ether Spider Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison damage and clumsy 1 (1 round) Stage 2 2d6 (2d6) poison damage, clumsy 2 and slowed 1 (1 round) Stage 3 3d6 (3d6) poison damage, clumsy 3 and slowed 2 (1 round)

traits.name: Ethereal Step
traits.text: ⬻ The ether spider shifts to either the Ethereal Plane or the Material Plane. The ether spider can remain on the Ethereal Plane indefinitely without ill effect. While there, it can see clearly onto the Material Plane with a range of 60 feet. On its first round in an encounter, the ether spider can use this ability once as a free action.

traits.name: Ethereal Web Trap
traits.text: A creature hit by the ether spider's web attack is immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface (Escape DC 22).

traits.name: Web Burst
traits.text: ⬺ Frequency once per day Effect The ether spider flings a gout of stored webs in a 30-foot cone. These webs can pass between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. Each creature in the area is immobilized, as ethereal web trap, unless it succeeds at a DC 22 Reflex save.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fangs +15 (magical); Damage 1d10+7 (1d10+7) piercing plus ether spider venom and Grab

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ web +14 (magical, range increment 30 feet); Damage ethereal web trap
